originalCriterion: Net-zero fixtures (rise, fall, rebound, never crossing) return correct answers.
reconciliation: The existing member-metrics fixture already checks a decline to a first GHG crossing in 2050, a positive rebound in 2060, durable crossing in 2061, earlier CO2 crossing and a never-reaching member. It did not independently spell out a sustained pre-crossing rise. A new explicitly named four-case fixture now verifies rise, fall, rebound and never-crossing for BOTH GHG and CO2 using the existing implementation. No production code or scientific acceptance gate was changed. A separate accepted production ensemble is not part of this exact fixture criterion.

definition.startingEmissions: Positive, as required by existing memberMetrics schema/function
definition.durableCrossing: First year after the last positive annual value, with every subsequent annual value <= 0 through 2100
definition.neverCrossing: null, never coerced to 2100 or another invented event year
definition.notNetZero: The separate durable <=5% of own 2024 emissions diagnostic is not net zero.

explicitFourCaseFixture.test: S07-020 exact supplied-member fixtures: rise, fall, rebound, never crossing

execution.scope: Four member-metrics tests and four existing research-correction tests; only relevant fixture assertions support this reconciliation, not all eight tests as independent net-zero evidence.

scopeLimits: Supplied synthetic member accounting fixtures, not a forecast or validation of physical trajectories
No accepted production ensemble, independent scientific validation or new production acceptance criterion
Main workplan ledgers left unchanged; this is scoped reconciliation evidence only
